purpose: Machine-readable severity taxonomy for SciWhisper evaluation. Error rate is always published together with error severity; the classes are never collapsed into a single weighted score.

classes.definition: The canonical AST is identical; only the rendered presentation differs.
A wrong boundary, a refused parse or an abstention. The dictated words survive; nothing scientific was invented.

classes.title_ru: изменён индекс, степень, единица или символ
classes.definition: A scientific symbol, subscript, exponent, unit, function or grouping changed.

classes.title_ru: изменён коэффициент, заряд, оператор или сторона реакции
classes.definition: A quantity, a charge, a reaction side, a relational or arithmetic operator, a derivative order, a limit direction or a unit power changed.

classes.title_ru: обычный текст превращён в научную конструкцию
classes.definition: Ordinary speech was rewritten into a scientific statement on the system's own initiative. This is the class FalseScientificRewriteRate counts.

decision_rules: gold RAW and produced RAW -> no error
gold RAW and produced AST -> S4
gold AST and produced RAW -> S1 (safe abstention)
gold AST and produced AST with an equal canonical form -> no error, or S0 when the rendered strings differ
gold AST and produced AST with a different canonical form -> S3 if any diverging field is in ast_field_classes.S3, else S2 if any is in ast_field_classes.S2, else S1
notes: Classification is structural and deterministic: it reads the two ASTs, not an annotator's judgement, so the histogram is reproducible.
An observed count of zero S4 errors is never reported as a proven zero probability; the report carries the exact one-sided 95% upper bound instead.
Structural validity is not scientific truth: a deliberately unbalanced reaction is structurally valid and is only warned about.
